channel.title: Secrets on KubeSphere
channel.description: Recent content in Secrets on KubeSphere

item.title: Create a Secret
item.description: This section describes how to create a Secret. Prerequisites You need to join a cluster and have the cluster-admin role in the cluster. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console as a user with the cluster-admin role and go to your cluster. Click Configuration > Secret in the left navigation pane. Click Create on the page. On the Basic Information tab, set the basic information for the Secret, then click Next.

item.title: View Secret List
item.description: This section describes how to view the Secret list. Prerequisites You need to join a cluster and have the cluster-viewer role within the cluster. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console as a user with the cluster-viewer role and enter your cluster. Click Configuration > Secret in the left navigation pane. The Secret list provides the following information: Parameter Description Name

item.title: View Secret Details
item.description: This section describes how to view Secret details. Prerequisites You need to be a member of a cluster and have the cluster-viewer role within the cluster. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console as a user with the cluster-viewer role and navigate to your cluster. Click Configuration > Secret in the left navigation pane. In the Secret list, click the name of a Secret to open its details page.

item.title: Edit Secret Information
item.description: This section describes how to edit Secret information. You can edit the alias and description of a Secret. KubeSphere does not support editing the name of a Secret. Prerequisites You need to be a member of a cluster and have the cluster-admin role within the cluster. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console as a user with the cluster-admin role and go to your cluster.

item.title: Edit Secret Settings
item.description: This section describes how to edit the settings of a Secret. You can edit the data of a Secret. KubeSphere does not support editing the type of a Secret. Prerequisites You need to join a cluster and have the cluster-admin role within the cluster. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console as a user with the cluster-admin role and enter your cluster.

item.title: Delete a Secret
item.description: This section describes how to delete a Secret. Warning A Secret cannot be recovered after deletion. Please perform this operation with caution. Prerequisites You need to join a cluster and have the cluster-admin role in the cluster. Delete a Single Secret Log in to the KubeSphere web console as a user with the cluster-admin role and go to your cluster.
